description: Navigate to the 'Create the fractions' activity in GCompris (under Math > Numeration). In this activity, you must represent a given numerical fraction (e.g., 3/4) by clicking segments of a pie chart or rectangle. Solve 3 consecutive problems correctly. For each problem, record the target fraction (e.g., '3/4') into a text file at '/home/ga/fractions_log.txt' (one per line). After the 3rd success, take a screenshot of the completed state or success screen and save it to '/home/ga/fraction_success.png'.
